property_summary: For every valid call sending exactly 10 ether at a strictly later timestamp, the contract pays out (balance becomes 0) if and only if block.number % 15 == 0; the mutant pays on the complementary blocks, so at some block numbers its balance differs from 0 exactly when the reference keeps funds.
change_summary: Invert the block number condition to 'block.number % 15 != 0' so payouts happen on a different set of blocks.
